name: Weekly AI for Small Business blog batch
description: Each Monday, publish the next scheduled AI for Small Business blog batch from pre-written batchN.py modules (batches 4–7 queued for Aug 10/17/24/31).
prompt:
Prefer the GitHub Action `.github/workflows/weekly-small-business-blog.yml`, which auto-publishes when `batchN.py` exists.

If running manually in Cursor:
1. Read peacemakers-ai/scripts/small-business-articles/batch-schedule.json and find the next batch where status is not published and scheduled_date <= today.
2. Confirm the batch module exists.
3. Run: python3 peacemakers-ai/scripts/publish-due-batch.py --deploy
4. Verify live URLs return HTTP 200.

Do not invent credentials. If Vercel deploy fails, report the missing secret checklist.
